request.query: Studies using the UCI Online Shoppers Purchasing Intention Dataset or comparable session-level ecommerce data that test whether calendar special-day proximity moderates the association between informational-page browsing duration and completed purchase, controlling for page count and visitor type.
request.missing_relation: Whether this specific calendar-proximity-by-informational-browsing contrast has been directly studied.
request.change_if_found: If closely overlapping work exists, describe this as a replication or identify a genuinely distinct measurement or comparison; metadata search results alone cannot establish a literature gap.
